verdict.rationale: Mastra documents built-in scorers that use model-graded, rule-based and statistical methods to give quantifiable agent-quality metrics, plus live evaluations that score outputs in real time. Nothing in the pack shows these evals running in a CI pipeline, so only the scoring half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (test-runner or CI pipeline usage), dataset/batch eval runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI

citations.quote: Scorers are automated tests that evaluate Agents outputs using model-graded, rule-based, and statistical methods.
Scorers help bridge this gap by providing quantifiable metrics for measuring agent quality.
Live evaluations allow you to automatically score AI outputs in real-time as your agents and workflows operate.
